name: tabminal
description: A modern, persistent web terminal with multi-tab support and real-time system monitoring. Powered by Bun runtime.

scripts.build:binary: bun run build-assets.mjs && bun run build-binary.mjs
scripts.build:binary:linux: bun run build-assets.mjs && bun run build-binary.mjs --target linux-x64
scripts.build:binary:macos: bun run build-assets.mjs && bun run build-binary.mjs --target darwin-arm64
scripts.build:binary:windows: bun run build-assets.mjs && bun run build-binary.mjs --target windows-x64
scripts.build:binary:all: bun run build-assets.mjs && bun run build-binary.mjs --all

author: Leask Wong
